Bento (bento.me) link-in-bio pages

A Berlin web app of 2022–2026 that let anyone build a personal page as a grid of rounded tiles in several sizes, and took its name from the layout.

Source
Tech.eu: Sequoia-backed Bento boxed up by Linktree (Dan Taylor, 2023-06-06) (archived copy)
Creator
Bento (Sélim Benayat, co-founder and CEO)
Made
2022–2026 (founded 2022, public launch February 2023 according to Tech.eu; shut down 2026-02-13)
Style
Bento grid (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods

Inspected the Wayback Machine copy of the co-founder’s page bento.me/selim of 2023-09-27, captured at 1440 × 900 on 2026-10-02. Only the first screen was inspected. An archived copy of bento.me/bento shows only “No profile found” and was not used. Not stored.

Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Tech.eu reports that Bento was founded in Berlin in 2022, backed by Sequoia’s Arc programme, launched publicly in February 2023, and was acquired by Linktree in June 2023, with the whole team joining Linktree.

AlternativeTo reported on 2025-12-21 that Bento would shut down on 2026-02-13 and that its links would redirect to Linktree (AlternativeTo).

Taplink describes the editor: “You can make each block large, small, horizontal, vertical, or square”, with “almost no design settings” (Taplink, updated 2026-04-29).

Observed

  • The page is white. A left column holds a round profile photo, the name “Sélim” in large bold black type, and the line “Builder and bento fanatic” in grey.
  • The right two thirds hold a two-column grid of white tiles with large rounded corners, wide even gaps, a very light grey hairline edge, and a faint shadow.
  • Tiles come in at least three sizes: tall link tiles with a small icon, a title, and a grey domain; a large square photo tile; and short wide tiles with one line of text.
  • Section headings (“Find me on the internet ↓”, “Get to know me ↓”) sit on the white ground between groups of tiles, not inside a tile.
  • A small violet “Create Your Bento” button sits at the bottom left.

Why it belongs

The product is named after the layout, which shows how widely the word “bento” was attached to tile grids by 2022–2023. Its tiles are white on white, so a hairline and a faint shadow replace the tonal step of the Apple slides.

Borrow

Offer each block in a few fixed shapes (small, wide, tall, large square) on a two- or four-column grid, so that users cannot break the grid.

Keep the identity column fixed beside the grid on wide screens and above it on narrow screens.

A growing catalogue of visual references. Rights and removal
